# S Davison (Electrical) Ltd

> Commercial and industrial electrical contractor in South Shields, Tyne and Wear, working across the North East of England. Family-owned, incorporated 2005, company number 05595351.

- Email: info@sdavisonelectrical.com
- Phone: 07900 817 149
- Address: Unit 316 South Shields Business Works, Henry Robson Way, South Shields, Tyne and Wear, NE33 1RF
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm
- Accreditations: CHAS Advanced, CHAS Principal Contractor, NICEIC

## Services
- [Installation and rewiring](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/electrical-installation-and-rewiring.html): New installations, full and partial rewires, and changes to existing systems
- [Lighting and LED upgrades](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/lighting.html): Lighting for offices, shops, warehouses, factories and production areas
- [Emergency lighting](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/emergency-lighting.html): Emergency lighting for workplaces, schools and public buildings
- [CCTV](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/cctv.html): CCTV for crime prevention and detection, supplied and fitted for businesses across the North East
- [Door entry and access control](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/door-entry-and-access-control.html): When a building has a large team, keys stop being enough
- [Data cabling](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/data-cabling.html): Data cabling for offices and commercial buildings, including computer rooms and office reconfigurations
- [Testing and inspection](https://sdavisonelectrical.com/testing-and-inspection.html): The Health and Safety at Work etc
